name: Returns Tracker
description: Never miss a return deadline: orders, countdowns and refund status in one place.
prompt: Track online orders and returns: shop, item, price, order date, return deadline with a countdown, status from ordered to refunded, and reminders of returns about to expire.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: No te pases nunca del plazo de devolución: pedidos, cuentas atrás y estado del reembolso en un solo sitio.
